final:
rotl8(x: u8, k: int) -> u8 =
  pre k >= 0 and k <= 7
  post int(out) == (int(x) * (1 << k)) % 256 + int(x) // (1 << (8 - k))
  ex rotl8(129 as u8, 1) == 3 as u8
  ex rotl8(1 as u8, 0) == 1 as u8
  ex rotl8(1 as u8, 7) == 128 as u8
  let v = int(x)
  let r = (v * (1 << k)) % 256 + v // (1 << (8 - k))
  r as u8
